title: Zenith Creamy Korean Fennel Bisque
description: A fresh and creamy Korean dish featuring fennel bulb, perfect for a hangover cure, made with ingredients from Jeju and cooked in a bamboo steamer to reduce gluten-friendly concerns.
instructions: In a blender, puree the chopped fennel bulb, korean chili flakes, garlic, and ginger until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the coconut milk, chicken broth, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pureed fennel mixture to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a bamboo steamer lined with parchment paper.
Steam the mixture over boiling water for 10 minutes or until heated through.
Remove the bisque from the steamer and let it cool slightly.
Serve the bisque hot, garnished with chopped green onions and a sprinkle of korean chili flakes if desired.
